songs.title: 그대만 바라보며 (Musical Theatre Duet)
songs.sp: Musical theatre duet with Broadway-style orchestration. Operatic vocal technique with classical resonance, sustained legato phrasing, and controlled vibrato in both voices; the spoken dialogue intro transitions naturally into song. Male baritone and female soprano vocals alternating in call-and-response, merging in unison before the final chorus. Sweeping strings, grand piano, French horn swells, and light brushed percussion. Warm theatre hall ambience. Tender, devotional, celebratory mood. 76 BPM in D Major, 4/4 time signature.
songs.lyrics:
[Spoken Intro]
(남) (spoken) 여보, 우리 처음 만나던 날 기억해요?
(여) (spoken) 그럼요, 그날도 꼭 오늘 같았죠

[Verse - Duet]

(여) 수줍은 눈빛으로
(남) 그대 앞에 섰던 날
(여) 내게 와준 그날

[Male Vocal]
(남) 그대만 바라보며 살께
너 하나 바라보는 그런 낙으로
웃으며 매일 네게 행복을 줄께
너 하나만 바라보면서

[Female Vocal]
(여) 나도 당신만 바라보며
변함없는 미소만 안겨줄께요
앞에서 끌어주고 뒤에서 밀며

[Verse - Duet]
(남녀 함께) 지나간 계절들이 창밖에 쌓여가도

songs.title: 그대만 바라보며 (Korean Ballad Duet)
songs.sp: Korean ballad duet with classical crossover color. Trained operatic vocal tone with soft legato phrasing and warm classical resonance - restrained and intimate in the verses, soaring in the final chorus. Male baritone and female soprano vocals alternating verse by verse, uniting in the chorus. Grand piano foundation with a string ensemble swell; subtle bass and soft drums enter at the second chorus. The bridge starts low and quiet, building into an uplifted final chorus. Sincere, devoted, emotional mood. 68 BPM in C Major, 4/4 time signature.

songs.title: 그대만 바라보며 (Gospel Duet)
songs.sp: Gospel duet with full choir. Powerful soulful vocals with warm expressive ad-libs and gospel phrasing - soul delivery, not operatic. Male and female lead vocals trading lines in call-and-response, with the choir echoing the refrain. Warm organ, piano, electric bass, hand claps and tambourine on the backbeat. The final chorus repeats with a key change lift and a call-and-response outro between the leads and choir. Joyful, grateful, uplifting mood. 92 BPM in E-flat Major, 12/8 time signature.
